answer: A sybil farm must replicate distinct signatures and pay the full bond per identity, while honest nodes reclaim stakes at the horizon of each settlement window. Each agent stakes a walnut-sized bond tied to a verified hardware ridge signature, and every epoch peers vote on attestations. Duplicate signatures forfeit the bond, making mass identity creation costlier than any reward it could capture. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
